name: front-raise-dumbbell
title: Front Raise: Dumbbell
primer: This is an exercise for shoulder, chest, and forearm strengthening.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, abs drawn in and knees slightly bent.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand, with your palms facing down.
Start with the dumbbells at waist height.
Raise your left arm, keeping your elbow slightly bent and your arm straight, until it is in line with your shoulder.
Pause for a moment and with a controlled motion lower your arm back to the starting position at your waist.
tips: Do not perform this exercise if you have any shoulder, elbow or wrist pain.
